idea-plugin.name: Copy File Path with Line Numbers (AI Prompt)
idea-plugin.description:
Copy a correct, paste-ready file path with line numbers from the active JetBrains editor with predictable formatting and minimal friction.

Copy File Path with Line Numbers (AI Prompt) stays intentionally narrow: it copies deterministic absolute or project-relative references for saved local files only, using normalized path:line and path:start-end output for AI prompting, reviews, and notes.

  • Absolute and relative copy actions with workspace fallback
  • POSIX-style forward slashes on every platform
  • Clear failure feedback for unsupported editor states
